## 3.3 Import the Daily Grids as stars Data Cubes
```{r}
#| label: locate-daily-files

files_2009 <- list.files(
  "oisst_lab_data/oisst_daily/el_nino_2009-12",
  pattern = "\\.nc$",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  sort()

files_2010 <- list.files(
  "oisst_lab_data/oisst_daily/la_nina_2010-12",
  pattern = "\\.nc$",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  sort()

length(files_2009)

stopifnot(
  length(files_2009) == 31,
  length(files_2010) == 31
)

c(
  first_2009 = basename(first(files_2009)),
  last_2009 = basename(last(files_2009)),
  first_2010 = basename(first(files_2010)),
  last_2010 = basename(last(files_2010))
)
```

### 3.3.1 Inspect Imported Data via read_star
```{r}
# December 2009: 31 daily grids
dec_2009 <- read_stars(files_2009, sub = c("anom", "ice"), along="time")

# December 2010: 31 daily grids
dec_2010 <- read_stars(files_2010, sub = c("anom", "ice"), along="time")

# Inspect
dec_2009
dec_2010
```

## 3.4 Establish the Coordinate Reference System
``` {r}
# Assign EPSG:4326 to both stars objects
dec_2009 <- st_set_crs(dec_2009, 4326)
dec_2010 <- st_set_crs(dec_2010, 4326)

# Check CRS
st_crs(dec_2009)
st_crs(dec_2010)

# check boundary
st_bbox(dec_2009)
st_bbox(dec_2010)
```

## 3.5 Calculate monthly summaries
## Monthly cell summaries

```{r}
#| label: monthly-summary-function

summarise_month <- function(daily_cube) {
  mean_anom <- st_apply(
    daily_cube["anom"],
    c("x", "y"),
    mean,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  names(mean_anom) <- "mean_anom"

  ice_zero <- daily_cube["ice"]
  ice_zero[[1]][is.na(ice_zero[[1]])] <- 0

  mean_ice <- st_apply(
    ice_zero,
    c("x", "y"),
    mean
  )
  names(mean_ice) <- "mean_ice"

  result <- c(mean_anom, mean_ice) |>
    mutate(
      land = is.nan(mean_anom) & mean_ice == 0,
      mean_ice = replace(mean_ice, land, NA_real_)
    )

  result[c("land", "mean_anom", "mean_ice")]
}
```

```{r}
#| label: calculate-monthly-summaries

summary_2009 <- summarise_month(dec_2009)
summary_2010 <- summarise_month(dec_2010)
```

## Verifier Task
```{r}
#| label: verify-monthly-summaries

verify_monthly_summary <- function(monthly, daily) {
  non_land_ice <- monthly$mean_ice[!monthly$land]

  stopifnot(
    all(dim(monthly) == c(1440, 720)),
    identical(names(st_dimensions(monthly)), c("x", "y")),
    identical(names(monthly), c("land", "mean_anom", "mean_ice")),
    !anyNA(monthly$land),
    all(is.na(monthly$mean_ice) == monthly$land),
    min(non_land_ice, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0,
    max(non_land_ice, na.rm = TRUE) <= 1,
    isTRUE(all.equal(st_bbox(monthly), st_bbox(daily))),
    isTRUE(all.equal(st_res(monthly), st_res(daily))),
    st_crs(monthly) == st_crs(daily)
  )

  tibble(
    dimensions = paste(dim(monthly), collapse = " × "),
    land_cells = sum(monthly$land),
    non_land_cells = sum(!monthly$land),
    minimum_ice = min(non_land_ice, na.rm = TRUE),
    maximum_ice = max(non_land_ice, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

bind_rows(
  `2009` = verify_monthly_summary(summary_2009, dec_2009),
  `2010` = verify_monthly_summary(summary_2010, dec_2010),
  .id = "year"
)
```
